Author: @adamc91
Content:
Here’s a handy one that I like to use on my iPhone! If my memory serves me right, I don’t recall ever seeing it shared before (but it’s likely well known tbf lol)

To select all the text within an editable text box, (that has more than one paragraph - otherwise just triple tap a word - which selects everything in that paragraph/continuous block of text).
Double or triple-tap on a word to highlight it, (I normally use the very first word at the beginning of the text), then drag one of the blue dots (selection handles) to the left so it goes outside of the text box - this will then cause everything within the text box to be highlighted.. and it doesn’t matter how long the text is! 
It’s likely the easiest and quickest way to select all the text within the text box, especially if it’s very long - to then copy, and paste elsewhere. 

It might not work everywhere (unfortunately doesn’t work here in yt comments) but does work well on most/if not all webpages with editable text fields, like on forms or text areas on websites (or at least it has worked on the text boxes/fields that I’ve typed in on websites). 

Hopefully I’ve explained it well - so that it makes sense lol and I hope someone who previously didn’t know this - now finds it useful 😊
